purpose: Repair strict support and freeze native browser/export replay without replacing historical statistical failures.
known_before_run: The old Python report used the missing-XOR variant and is superseded by the preserved port-correction audit.
Native seed 2463401483 starts with U=0 and produces a boundary point.
The unchanged native 4D radial diagnostic was previously reported at p approximately 0.01106, below the original per-test 0.05 threshold.
This is an unblinded repair/regression, not a new confirmatory statistical experiment.
same_runtime_export: byte-identical after regeneration; no timestamp in application export
cross_runtime: PRNG integers, flags, counts exact; coordinates and inference use fixed tolerance
boundary_policy: Reject u_A=0 immediately; otherwise use the unchanged transform; reject invalid directions or candidates failing finite strict support. At most 128 attempts per accepted point, then throw without a partial result.

time_and_radial.test: two-sided one-sample KS vs U(0,1), pooled four seeds within dimension
time_and_radial.origin: Original V1b sections 9 and 10; unchanged, no multiplicity adjustment used to rescue this gate.

angular_moments.origin: New explicit diagnostic screen; the old report gave no quantitative tolerance.

expanded_counts.origin: New expanded-grid screen fixed before this run; does not replace the original time/radial gates.

statistics.interpretation: Finite deterministic PRNG samples are not proven iid. These are regression discrepancy screens, not proofs of independence or uniformity.

stop_rule: Run once over the fixed matrix; retain every result. Do not tune seeds, sampler, thresholds or test family in response to p-values. Overall PASS requires engineering and every declared diagnostic gate. A diagnostic failure leaves overall NOT_PASSED.
